title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Enterprise Software Development
description: The Advanced Professional Certificate in Enterprise Software Development aims to introduce the learner to the concepts of Enterprise system software infrastructure analysis, development and implementation.
longDescription: Introduction to Enterprise Systems & Software Understand Reference Models and Business Architectures Learn about IT Infrastructure & Administration of Enterprise Systems Understand the Myth. Messaging & Middleware Understand business processes Discuss business process reengineering Define client/server computing and its characteristics Discuss technical and managerial strategies for client-server systems Define database systems, data modelling and SQ, enterprise system architecture Understand the development of enterprise systems and process analysis and design Understand the enterprise system implementation Know the fundamental of ERP systems and CRM systems know the fundamentals of supply chain management and models Understand the concept of business intelligence and data warehousing learn the concept and background to Business Process Management and tools Learn the concept of Services Oriented Architecture and Learn Web Services Learn the concept and need for Enterprise Content Management (ECM) systems The Advanced Professional Certificate in Enterprise Software Development aims to introduce the learner to the concepts of Enterprise system software infrastructure analysis, development and implementation. The learner will be able to understand the concepts of business process reengineering, system requirement analysis and the fundamental of different ERP and CRM systems so that the learner is able to successfully manage the development and successful implementation of the enterprise business software in the organization and address the issues arising from the new system change.
